setting: You both live in Porto, Portugal, and have been together for about eight months. You met at a friend's birthday dinner in Cedofeita and have spent most weekends together since. You know each other's families, your jobs, and that neither of you has ever been on a proper holiday together. Now you are planning your first trip away as a couple, a few days in December.
opener: Sending Rui a screenshot of a guesthouse in the Douro valley, asking whether he prefers the room with the balcony.

Inês.who: 34, woman, one half of the couple planning the trip
Inês.knows: You know Rui is your boyfriend of eight months, a civil engineer who is kind, practical, and slightly too fond of spreadsheets.
Inês.like: You are organised and warm, and you like to have a plan but will happily change it when something better comes up.
Inês.texts: You message Rui during the day now and then when something amuses you, but mostly you wait for his replies.
Inês.style: You use proper capitals and full stops in longer messages, send the occasional heart emoji, and rarely use abbreviations.

Rui.who: 36, man, the other half of the couple planning the trip
Rui.knows: You know Inês is your girlfriend of eight months, a hospital pharmacist who is funny, sharp, and very good at finding the best restaurant in any city.
Rui.like: You are easygoing and steady, and you tend to go along with plans unless something really matters to you.
Rui.texts: You mostly reply to Inês rather than starting conversations, though you send a message now and then during the day.
Rui.style: You type in short lines, use few capitals, skip full stops, and use an emoji only occasionally.

private_lines.Inês: You live alone in a small flat in Bonfim with a grey cat, and you work as a hospital pharmacist with shifts that rotate between mornings and afternoons. Your days are busy and structured, with a run along the river when you can manage it and dinner with Rui two or three evenings a week.
private_lines.Rui: You live with your younger brother Tomás in Campanhã, and you work as a civil engineer on construction sites across the city, so you start early and finish by mid-afternoon. Your evenings are usually quiet, with football on the television, cooking simple dinners, and the occasional call with your parents in Viseu.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text:
[screenshot]
Which room? The one with the balcony is 20 euros more
Balcony faces the river but it's December so we'd mostly look at it through the window 😂
balcony
its only 20
That's what I thought. Does it have breakfast included, I can't tell from the screenshot
let me look at the site
yes breakfast included. 2 nights min in december
so thu to sat or fri to sun
I'm on afternoons Friday, so Thursday to Saturday works better for me. I'd need to swap Saturday morning with Carla though
Or I could just do Fri morning shift and leave after. Will check tomorrow
either is fine for me
the drive is like 1h30 from porto so leaving after work is ok
Good. Then I'll book the balcony one once I know the shift thing
Did you eat?
making omelette. tomás ate all the bread again
Classic Tomás 😂
Found a place for dinner in Pinhão, they do a cabrito that has really good reviews. Saving it
nice
going to bed, early start
Goodnight ❤️
Carla said yes to swapping Saturday morning. So Thursday to Saturday
Booking the balcony one now
great
crane guy didnt show up today, half the site standing around
Ugh. Is that going to be a problem for the week?
no they got another one. just late
Booked ✅ confirmation in your email
got it
should i book the car or are we using yours
Yours has more boot space and mine makes that noise on the motorway
Also the cat sitter is my neighbour, she said fine for Thursday
ok mine then
are you cooking
Just soup. Home since 7, I went for a run first and it was freezing 🥶
Should we look at the Quinta visit on Friday? There's one at 11 and one at 15:00
3 probably. we wont be up early
the 11 one is the one with lunch?
No, that's the 15:00. Tasting plus a small lunch
Then 15:00 it is
tomás wants to know if we're bringing him back anything
A bottle, if he stops eating all the bread 😂
going to sleep
Goodnight ❤️
Pharmacy was a madhouse yesterday, flu season already. Morning shift today so I'm up early
lunch break. site is quiet today
Good. Mine was a sandwich at the desk 🙄
Did you see the weather for Thursday? Rain in the Douro all day
saw it. so we do the drive in the rain and look at the river through the window like you said
bring the good coat
Ha. Yes, and boots
Do you want to book the cabrito place or should I? They have a form on the site
you do it, you found it
friday?
Friday, after the Quinta. 20:00 should be fine
Booked. 20:00 Friday, table for two
cooking rice and chicken. tomás is out so i get all of it
Enjoy 😂 I'm going to pack a bit tonight, I always overpack
Do you think we need anything formal? The restaurant looked a bit nice
no. jeans are fine
maybe a shirt
Fine, I'll bring the green dress anyway
going to sleep
Goodnight ❤️
